title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Cherry Ice Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod combines juicy Cherry flavour with a clean icy finish. The sweet fruit base is brightened by a frosty exhale, creating a flavour that tastes cool, balanced, and refreshing from start to finish. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that keeps the pod topped up automatically. This system provides up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for manual refilling or coil changes. Using a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod delivers consistent vapour and full-bodied flavour from start to finish. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and start vaping.
